signature.one_line: Zero-cut cream-canvas UI explainer; three-state grey-to-black karaoke line; result-first progress hook.
unique_devices: Three-state karaoke line on cream: upcoming words light grey, spoken words mid grey, current word near-black, one line of 3-5 words, no box or stroke
Zero hard cuts: the presenter slides out and back while full-screen UI mock-ups on the same cream canvas carry ~70 % of runtime, a new UI element every ~1-2 s

Result-first hook: 'what you pay for' -> 'your version' cards with a progress bar filling to 100 % and a small time badge, landing inside the first ~6 % of runtime under a 2-line headline with the key verb in a accent box
Caption rides the gap between the top graphics band (10-35 % H) and the presenter's head, dropping to ~70 % H when graphics fill the frame
signature.why_it_works: Promise and visual proof land together before doubt sets in; constant UI motion replaces cuts so a dense, pause-free voice never feels static.

hook.first_frame: Cream background, 2-line black headline at the top with one word in a accent box, two white UI cards with a progress bar below it, presenter head-and-shoulders in the bottom half, one karaoke caption line between graphics and head

structure.what: spoken promise + headline with accent-boxed verb + before/after UI cards and a progress bar filling to 100 %
motion-blur whip out of the presenter; phone mock-up with stacking subscription notifications and a accent cost callout
presenter returns under two phones: original vs own version, zero-price tag, feature toggles switching on
full-screen graphics: the speaker's own version shared in a group chat card
code-repository screenshot, then one phone mock-up per step of the toolkit
twist: store review cards are read and fixed; the result becomes something you can sell
presenter returns; mock social comment with a keyword + DM card with a link; follow ask

pacing.pace: single continuous composition (no hard cuts); motion-graphics-driven

captions.how: centred, centre y 40.3 % H when the presenter is in frame, 69.5 % H when graphics are full-screen; whole phrase hard-cuts in on its first word; highlight switches in 1 frame within ±1 frame of each word start; hard cut to next phrase

background_text.what: 2-line hook headline with one key word on a accent box
background_text.how: centred, lines at 12.8-18.8 % H, Inter 700 63 px near-black; accent box ~3.75 % H tall, ~6 px radius behind the key word; static, leaves with the whip

motion_graphics.what: before/after UI cards + progress bar 2 % -> 100 % + small accent time badge
motion_graphics.how: two white rounded cards at x 7-46 % and 54-92 %, y 21-32 %; thin green progress bar counts up synced to the spoken promise; badge pops at 100 %

motion_graphics.what: phone mock-ups: notification stack, zero-price tag, settings toggles, group chat, repository screenshot, review cards
motion_graphics.how: cards slide/scale in on the cream canvas with soft shadows; a new element every ~1-2 s; ease-out ~8-12 frames
accent rounded box with bold black number + small grey line, ~x 42-76 %, y ~51-55 %

cards_lists.what: one phone mock-up per step of a multi-part process
cards_lists.how: full-screen graphics, each step a new card replacing the last

broll_inserts.what: full-screen designed UI scenes instead of footage
broll_inserts.how: presenter hidden; same cream canvas so no visible cut

layout.what: stacked band layout on a cream canvas
layout.how: graphics band 10-35 % H, caption ~40 % H, presenter head-and-shoulders in the bottom ~55 %

camera.how: static medium close-up; all motion comes from graphics

transitions.what: single motion-blur whip out of the presenter
transitions.how: horizontal motion blur ~6-8 frames, presenter slides out, graphics take over

transitions.what: presenter slides/fades out and back while UI cards animate in/out

end_card.what: mock social comment with a keyword + DM card with a link
end_card.how: presenter returns in the bottom half; comment card then DM card animate in above

case.caption: sentence case as spoken (capital on sentence starts and proper nouns)

grouping.sync: phrase shown whole on its first word; the highlight moves word by word on each word start
grouping.break: hard cut to the next phrase on the first word of the next phrase

layout.rule: the caption sits in the gap between the UI graphic block (top ~10-35 %) and the presenter's head (from ~45 %); when the presenter is hidden it drops to ~70 % H under the graphic

caption.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, wide round C and o, straight-tailed y, flat-topped t, wide letter widths (Montserrat traits); Poppins has a single-storey a
caption.calibration_note: each calibration word measured as the active (near-black) word on clean cream
caption.color: three states: upcoming #D1CCC2 (light grey), already spoken #9C968C (mid grey), current word #161410 (near-black); background cream #F1EDE3

headline.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, single-storey g with hook, flat terminals, compact grotesque widths
headline.calibration_note: 4-word sentence-case line measured at 2.97 % H ink, 56.1 % W; calibration phrase withheld (source text)
headline.box: yellow highlight box on the key word: #FBD409, ~3.75 % H tall, small radius ~6 px @1080, text stays black
headline.position: 2 centred lines at y 12.8-18.8 % (line centres 14.3 % and 17.3 %), persistent for the hook (~8 % of runtime)

animation.phrase_entry: hard cut: the whole next phrase appears in 1 frame on its first word, first word already near-black
animation.highlight: colour switch in 1 frame per word, within ±1 frame of the word start; the previous word drops to mid grey #9C968C, later words stay light grey #D1CCC2
animation.exit: hard cut on the next phrase

other_text_spec.text: 'Headline here. / Second line with KEY WORD' - black bold grotesque, 2 centred lines at 12.8-18.8 % H; yellow #FBD409 box behind the key word

two white rounded cards (x 7-46 % and 54-92 %, y 21-32 %): 'what you pay for' (app icon + red recurring-cost label) -> 'your version' (icon + 'building…' -> green 'free, yours'), a thin progress bar filling 2 % -> 100 % and a yellow time badge
yellow rounded box with a bold black number + small explanatory line, ~x 42-76 %, y ~51-55 % (estimated)

phone mock-ups, notification stack, zero-price tag, settings toggles, group-chat card, code-repository screenshot, store review cards, social-app comment with a keyword + DM card with a link (designed UI, small grotesque text)

style.look_intent: bright warm cream canvas, low-saturation, high-contrast black type, natural skin, soft radial vignette; colour only in graphics (yellow highlight, green success, red cost)

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected); flat, heavily compressed voice-led mix
sfx: none detected; no hard cuts to hit (single take)
optional soft whoosh on the single whip and light ticks on UI pops if a bed is added (inferred, not measured)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: The speaker is shot on a plain light background (or can be keyed onto one) and the topic is a tool, app or workflow that can be shown as UI
There are few or no usable cuts and the pace must come from graphics
The voice is dense and continuous (high wpm, no pauses) and the promise has a visual result that can be shown in the hook
The concept walks through a short multi-step process or toolkit
avoid_when: There is no time or budget to design a custom UI mock-up for nearly every line
The footage is dark, busy or outdoors (karaoke greys need a clean light background)
The piece relies on the speaker's on-camera presence or emotion
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B36 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B36.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. Speaker on a plain light canvas ({{SURFACE}}) in the bottom half, UI graphics in the top third.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: current-word {{TEXT}} must stay >= 7:1 on {{SURFACE}}, upcoming grey must stay visibly lighter than spoken grey, {{ACCENT}} box must keep >= 7:1 behind {{TEXT}})
- {{TEXT}}: default #161410 (current word, headline)
- {{ACCENT}}: default #FBD409 (headline key-word box, badges, cost callouts)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: default #9C968C (already-spoken words); upcoming words default #D1CCC2 (derive as a lighter tint of {{ACCENT_2}} toward {{SURFACE}})
- {{SURFACE}}: default #F1EDE3 (warm cream canvas behind speaker and graphics)
- {{CARD_BG}}: default #FFFFFF (UI cards, phone screens)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Inter 700 (headline)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Poppins 800 (captions; Montserrat ExtraBold is the closer original)
- {{HANDLE}}: default @handle (comment/DM CTA cards)
- {{LOGO}}: optional, inside UI cards only; never a corner bug

CAPTIONS
1. Latin, as spoken, sentence case, no punctuation, no emoji.
2. One line of 3-5 words per phrase; never 2 lines.
3. {{FONT_BODY}} at 60 px, tracking 0, no stroke, no shadow, no box.
4. Three states: whole phrase visible from its start in the upcoming grey (default #D1CCC2); the word being spoken in {{TEXT}}; words already spoken in {{ACCENT_2}}.
5. Centred. Centre y 40.3 % H while the speaker is in frame (gap between top graphics and head); 69.5 % H when a graphic fills the frame.
6. Phrase hard-cuts in on its first word (first word already {{TEXT}}); highlight jumps to each next word within ±1 frame of its start as a 1-frame colour switch; hard cut to the next phrase; no idle motion.

OTHER TEXT AND EDIT DEVICES
7. Hook headline (first ~8 % of runtime, ~90 frames): 2 centred lines in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 63 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking -0.01em, lines at 12.8-18.8 % H (centres 14.3 % / 17.3 %); {{ACCENT}} box (~3.75 % H tall, ~6 px radius) behind the one KEY WORD, text stays {{TEXT}}.
8. Result-first hook graphic: two {{CARD_BG}} rounded cards at x 7-46 % and 54-92 %, y 21-32 % ('what you pay for' -> 'your version'), a thin progress bar counting 2 % -> 100 % synced to the spoken promise, then a small {{ACCENT}} badge.
9. No hard cuts: the speaker slides out with one motion-blur whip (~6-8 frames) at ~8 % and returns for the claim and the CTA; for ~70 % of runtime full-screen UI mock-ups on {{SURFACE}} carry the story, a new element every ~1-2 s (slide/scale in, 8-12 frame ease-out, soft shadows).
10. When a cost or number is spoken, an {{ACCENT}} rounded callout with a bold {{TEXT}} number at ~x 42-76 %, y ~51-55 %.
11. CTA (last ~12 %): speaker returns; mock comment card with a keyword from {{HANDLE}} + DM card with a link animate in above the head.
12. No lower-thirds, no emoji, no end card.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: bright warm cream, low saturation, high-contrast black type, natural skin, soft vignette.
SOUND: voice-led, compressed, -14 LUFS, no music bed required; optional soft whoosh on the whip.

VERIFY
a) Render a test frame with a 4-word phrase whose current word is "with", centred at 40.3 % H, and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test_render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.43,0.37,0.62,0.45 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"   (default ink #161410)
   Required: "with" ink 2.5 % ±0.5 of H and 12.9 % ±2 of W; centre y 40.3 %. Second check: "sent" 2.11 % H, 12.5 % W.
b) Headline: render "KEY WORD" in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 63 px and measure with --box 0.15,0.12,0.85,0.158 --ink "{{TEXT}}:80"; expected ink for any word: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_DISPLAY}}" --word <word>.
c) If {{FONT_BODY}} is not Poppins 800, re-solve px with fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_BODY}}" --word with --ink 2.5 --width 12.9 and use that size.
